comments.author: Lemon30
comments.body:
Greetings, Warriors!

We're excited to announce the very soul of Battle Die Repeat - the Artificial Intelligence elements that empower the key mechanics of our game. Let's go over the two main AI-driven features of our upcoming title.

1. Rune-Magic

One of the foundational concepts in Battle Die Repeat are Runes - these mystical words you collect and combine to breathe life into your unique heroes.

Imagine collecting the Runes "Ice", "Knight", and "Dragon". Feed them into our game’s AI agent and, voilà! You've just summoned "Seraphel, the Frostscale Warden" - a stalwart Ice Dragonborn Knight, bearing ancient frost powers and revered for his resilience in battle.

Runes aren't just building blocks for your heroes. They define stats, characteristics, and each hero's unique blend of strengths and weaknesses. And it doesn't stop there - Runes also have rarities, and even the enemies are forged in the same Rune-Fire, making the process of hero summoning and rune combination a strategic journey of its own.

2. Autobattles

Enter the realm of Battle Die Repeat’s second major AI element - Autobattles. This AI-agent brings to life a 1v1 battle, pitting your hero against an enemy in an ever-changing, unpredictable, and dynamic combat scenario.

What makes it special? Every hero is unique. Every battle is different. Our AI ensures that every encounter is influenced by the unique characteristics of your hero and their opponent, making each autobattle a fresh experience.

Together, these mechanics allow you to push the boundaries of your imagination, experiment with runes, and create unique heroes to best your enemies in combat.

This is just a taste of what's in store, but we're eager to hear your thoughts and ideas. Engage in discussions, ask questions, and stay tuned for more exciting news in the upcoming week!

Stay brave, Stay curious!

The Battle Die Repeat Dev Team
